note: The bands the Edge plant has to land in, from docs/EDGE-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Extreme Flight's published figures for its 60 in Edge 540T, T-Motor's for the AM600, FlyingRC's review and the full size Edge 540's published roll rate (scripts/edge-derive.js prints the derived figures). Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

e1_level_75.source: level speed at three quarter throttle, the trim, derived 22.17; the band 15 percent either side

e2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 9.58; alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.90 / 4.797; the band the Kadet's in proportion

e3_glide.source: L/D at 1.4 Vs, 13.4 m/s, derived 8.75; the band 11 percent either side

e4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 29.70

e5_roll.source: full aileron at EF's high rate from level flight at 25 m/s, as the helix angle, derived 0.341 (641 deg/s) through the surface's knee, the band 20 percent either side; and at least the full size Edge 540's published 420 deg/s (Wikipedia, 'Zivko Edge 540'), the unlimited class

e5_low.source: the same on EF's low rate, 17.5 deg: derived 0.221, 20 percent either side

e6_pitch.source: half stick of up elevator from level at the trim, 11.2 deg through the expo and the knee: the time to the pitch rate's first peak on the linear longitudinal model, derived 0.089 s to 98 deg/s; the band 35 percent under and 50 over

e7_vertical.source: full throttle straight up: the speed where the thrust holds the weight and the drag, derived 21.49; 10 percent either side. EF: 'shocking vertical pullout from hover'

e8_inverted.source: a symmetric section at no incidence (the full size Edge's 'John Roncz symmetrical'): on its back at three quarter throttle it flies within 5 percent of its upright speed, stalls within 6 percent of its upright stall speed and rolls within 5 percent of its upright rate, and it holds level with 'just a bit of down elevator' (FlyingRC), under half stick

e9_snap.source: the edge of the envelope, from level at the trim with the ailerons centred. A yank, full up at once: the full throw asks alpha 21 deg against a 10.75 deg stall, an accelerated stall, and 'a full stall ... may be accompanied by an uncommanded rolling motion' (FAA-H-8083-3C, ch. 5); the build's asymmetry stalls one half first and it departs, a quarter turn or more of roll in 1.2 s where a trainer drops a wing under 30 deg (docs/STALL-STAGE1.md), and centred it stops within 0.3 s; half stick asks 9 deg, short of the stall, under 20 deg. The snap roll itself is AOPA's ('Technique: Snap rolls', Flight Training, September 2014): 'pull back hard on the stick' and 'add a strong yawing motion with rudder in the desired direction', 'a power-on spin': held 2 s it autorotates the rudder's way, upright and on its back: still turning at half its peak rate or more over the last half second of the hold, where a wing drop would have stopped, and three quarters of a turn at least, and AOPA's recovery, 'rudder opposite the direction of the turn, and reduce back-pressure', stops it within 0.5 s

e11_prop_torque.source: static full throttle, rolling left: ideal disc power 1.255, T-Motor's 1700 W electrical at 80 percent 1.31

e12_rest.source: the drawn model at rest, 9.84 deg and 0.2510 m, 15.4 percent on the tail

e13_takeoff.source: the throttle opened over a second on grass, the tail up at 6 m/s, rotated at 1.2 Vs to 10 deg at the pitch rate the pilot's stick gives: derived liftoff 4.69 m at 13.4 m/s in 1.24 s, the aircraft still accelerating hard through the rotation; the distance band the Cub's in proportion, 27 percent under and 45 over, the speed 15 percent either side

e14_straight.source: the same take off with the pilot's feet on the rudder and the tailwheel it steers: it tracks, as an aerobat on three times its weight in thrust does for a pilot who holds it

e15_taxi.source: full right rudder at walking pace, 0.18 throttle, 2.6 N of thrust against 2 N of rolling resistance once it moves: wheelbase over tan of the tailwheel's half of the rudder, 1.067 / tan 23.75 deg, derived 2.42, turning right

e16_landing.source: a powered approach, a flare and the tail held down: at rest on three wheels at E12's attitude, no hull contact, no prop strike

e17_unmoved.source: every other aircraft's recorded flight hash, as each one's own gates store it: the Edge's table, its knee and its strip ailerons, and the stalled lift taken on the stalling side, move none of them. Taken from main's module at 4ea84e3, before the Edge existed. The P-51's two recordings were added when it merged (main 5b710b9), their hashes the same on main's module and on this one.

e18_cross_host.source: the Edge's recorded take off, roll, inverted run and snap, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome
